name: Aihara Miku
source:
Table tennis star and friends with rena. She is often rena's prey when it comes to sexual harassment.

Since Miku was a child, she has been attracting attention on TV because of her table tennis skills, she became part of the National Table Tennis Team since she was a little girl.

She has to change her playstyle because the size of her boobs made it difficult for her to play properly, her childish and clumsy personality and her attractive and voluptuous body have caused her to have many male fans all over Japan.

"A challenge?!... I'll do my best!"
